methodology: The current selection comes only from upstream certificates/selected-result.json. Its immutable commit history and earlier upstream README checkpoints drive the main line; PR numbers never determine the reviewed selection. Original OpenAI and repository checkpoints use immutable source text at commit publication timestamps; the manuscript date is shown separately. PR bounds use current titles and descriptions at PR opening times. Drafts and lower-bound-only claims are marked. Method tags are phrase-based, include inherited methods, and are not expert classification. Field edges show co-mentions, not proof dependencies. PR references can denote comparisons as well as dependencies. No full-theorem verification is inferred from tests or certificates.
